name: FriendCodes
description: Generate FriendCodes to easily add friends
author: domi.btnr

changes.title: Now speaking German 🇩🇪
items: FriendCodes follows your Discord language and is now fully translated into German. Switch languages and it updates right away

changes.title: No more endless loading
items: The panel no longer gets stuck on "Loading..." when Discord doesn't respond. You can retry instead

changes.title: Feels like part of Discord
items: Rewrote the plugin from the ground up, making it lighter and less likely to break when Discord updates
The panel got a cleaner look that fits right in with the rest of the Add Friend page
Creating or revoking friend codes now tells you when something goes wrong, in the panel and in the slash commands
